description:
Implement polar code construction: bit-channel reliability sorting using Bhattacharyya parameters, information and frozen bit selection based on channel reliability, rate-compatible polar code families, and fast Hadamard-like transforms leveraging BitMatrix from gf2-core.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Implement polar code construction with bit-channel reliability” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Implement polar code construction with bit-channel reliability
